title: JWT CTF Lab: Build, Decode, and Verify Tokens

cover.alt: Conceptual three-part glass token with a gear, paper packet and signature seal

figures.title: Three token parts; two different questions
figures.summary: Readable claims are not automatically trusted claims.

items.label: Header
items.detail: Describes token type and signing algorithm.

items.label: Payload
items.detail: Contains readable claims; base64url is not encryption.

items.label: Signature
items.detail: Binds the header and payload to a signing key.

items.label: Verification
items.detail: Checks the signature, accepted algorithm and validity conditions.

figures.caption: Token structure and the verification boundary described in this lab.

figures.title: Prove the verifier rejects broken tokens
figures.summary: The lab tests failure paths alongside a valid token.

items.label: Valid token
items.detail: Verify an unmodified token with the expected key and algorithm.

items.label: Changed payload
items.detail: Editing a claim while keeping the old signature must fail verification.

items.label: Wrong secret
items.detail: A correctly shaped token still fails with the wrong verification key.

items.label: Expired token
items.detail: Verify the same token after expiration rather than issuing a new one.
